headline: Bitcoin is holding around $60,000 after Saturday's drop to a two-year low, with US stocks reopening Monday after Friday's sell-off and money still leaving US bitcoin funds.

market.asOf: Read by this desk on Sat 21 Nov at about 23:57-00:00 UTC (about 07:00 Sun Bangkok). Bitcoin and solana from CoinMarketCap; ether from Binance.US because CoinMarketCap's ether page could not be opened and CoinGecko's ether page showed a price that did not match other sources. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 12 out of 100, "Extreme Fear", on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index (read at about 23:58 UTC), the same as the day before.

stories.title: Bitcoin bounces back to about $60,000 after its lowest price in two years
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest price in about two years early on Saturday, then climbed back to around $60,000 as traders who had bet on further falls were pushed out. Many recent buyers are still sitting on losses, and Monday's US stock open is the next test.
points: Bitcoin fell as low as $55,251.60, its lowest level in two years, then rose back to about $59,952, per Reuters.
CoinDesk had bitcoin at about $60,300 on Saturday afternoon US time, up 1.5% over 24 hours, after a low of $55,130.
About $1.8 billion of crypto bets were liquidated over 24 hours, about $1.3 billion of them bets on higher prices, per CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk.
Holders locked in more than $11.3 billion of losses over 7 days, about 8 times their gains, per CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost cited by CoinDesk.
The average cost for recent (short-term) bitcoin buyers is $74,100, per Glassnode cited by crypto.news, so many are underwater.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds lose about $1.25 billion in a week
stories.summary: Money kept flowing out of US spot bitcoin ETFs, the funds that let people buy bitcoin through a normal brokerage account. Last week was one of the worst of a bad month, and BlackRock's fund had still not posted its Friday number.
points: Bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.25 billion over 16-20 Nov and ether ETFs about $221.7 million, per crypto.news.
Friday 20 Nov's provisional total was -$124.5 million, with BlackRock's IBIT still blank, per crypto.news using Farside data.
On Thursday 19 Nov bitcoin ETFs lost $582.3 million, $541.1 million of it from IBIT, per Bitcoin Sistemi via cryptonews.net.
November bitcoin ETF outflows total about $3.59 billion so far, per crypto.news.
CoinDesk put the week at about $1.1 billion net and said IBIT's Friday figures were still pending.

stories.title: Stock sell-off and Fed hike fears set up a big week for crypto
stories.summary: Friday's tech-led sell-off and expectations of a Fed rate hike in December are a big part of why crypto fell. US stocks reopen Monday 23 Nov, and inflation and growth data land on Wednesday 25 Nov before the Thanksgiving holiday.
points: In late Friday trading the S&P 500 was down about 3.5% and the Nasdaq about 5%, per Bitcoin Magazine.
Traders priced a more than 98% chance of a quarter-point December rate hike on Friday afternoon, per Bitcoin Magazine.
24/7 Wall St put the odds of a December hike at about 92% on Saturday, citing CME FedWatch.
PCE inflation and Q3 GDP come out on Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok), per the BEA schedule.

briefs.title: Chainflip drained of $4.86 million
briefs.summary: An attacker used what looks like Chainflip's own compromised signing key to empty its Ethereum vault of about $4.86 million into Tornado Cash; FLIP fell 34% and the protocol went into safe mode, per The Block.

briefs.title: Cyber bridge exploit; Upbit and Bithumb freeze CYBER
briefs.summary: About 5.213 million CYBER tokens were minted without permission on Solana and sold for about $968,000 in ETH; Upbit and Bithumb froze CYBER deposits and withdrawals, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kalshi faces a Monday court hearing in New York
briefs.summary: A Manhattan state court hears New York Attorney General Letitia James's request for a restraining order on Monday 23 Nov at 11:30am ET; Kalshi says the order would shut its exchange nationwide, per The Block.

briefs.title: XRP stays below $1
briefs.summary: XRP slid to about $0.87 as bets on higher prices were unwound, per The Crypto Basic.

briefs.title: Korean buyers pay a premium for bitcoin
briefs.summary: Bitcoin traded 1.83% higher on Korea's Upbit than on Binance, a gap known as the kimchi premium, per IT Times.

briefs.title: JPMorgan: bitcoin trades far below its mining cost
briefs.summary: JPMorgan estimates it costs about $86,000 to produce one bitcoin, which squeezes higher-cost miners, per The Block.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (second estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: PCE and Q3 GDP are both due at 8:30am ET, per the BEA schedule. Core PCE is expected at 3.2% a year (prior 3.1%), per Newsquawk. Q3 GDP is expected at 3.5% against the 3.4% first estimate, per Economic Weekly. Weekly jobless claims (last 203K) move to Wednesday for the holiday.
The Fed's survey of business conditions around the country, per the Fed's calendar. October new home sales come out earlier the same day at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok), per the Census Bureau.
On Friday 27 Nov US stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per NYSE. Crypto trades all day, but thin trading can mean bigger swings.

calendar.event: Monthly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit
calendar.note: About $6.76 billion of bitcoin options expire, with the "max pain" level at $73,000, per CryptoTicker using Deribit data from 21 Nov.
The last jobs report before the Fed decision, per the BLS schedule. JOLTS job openings come out Tue 1 Dec at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok); November CPI is Thu 10 Dec, the day after the Fed.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Two-day meeting 8-9 Dec, per the Fed's calendar. Odds of a quarter-point hike were about 92% per 24/7 Wall St citing CME FedWatch, and above 98% per Bitcoin Magazine. Fed officials stop public comment on policy from Sat 28 Nov, per the Fed's blackout rules.
